evidence_requirements_per_alias_or_versi: source version or explicit temporal applicability
literal alias or authoritative field-identity mapping
content hash when a binary/static artifact is acquired

acceptable_proof_routes.description: One or more authoritative FNDE/Olinda contract artifacts directly map aliases/fields to concepts and state an applicability range that covers every relevant interval.
Versioned official manuals, dictionaries, metadata or field documentation collectively create an unbroken semantic chain across 2016-2024.
Authoritative version/change history proves no relevant semantic change between documented alias-to-concept anchors.

acceptance_rule: Every alias used by a metric must have continuous proven semantic applicability across 2016-2024 and compatibility with the proven 2025 concept before that metric may become PROVEN_COMPARABLE.
partial_rule: Any unresolved year/version interval keeps the affected alias and every dependent metric PARTIAL.
negative_evidence_rule: A documented semantic change may classify an alias/metric NON_COMPARABLE unless an explicit adapter/rebase contract is proven.
